notes.title: Playtest v0.10.0
notes.notes:
As announced on [url=https://twitch.tv/sir_brokealot]the stream[/url] today we will have another playtest upcoming Sunday! Save the date:

[b]Sunday, 27th October, 7pm CET / 6pm UTC[/b]

We're introducing a mechanism to cope with battles taking too long if players sink each other's ships equally fast, sometimes referred to as: "the comeback mechanism".

The more ships you lose, the more alert the crews of your other ships will be, so that they just work faster. The cooldown time for the ships' weapons will come down to 50% for the last remaining ship.

Signup will open on Sunday way before the event starts so you'll have plenty of time downloading the game beforehand. For a detailed list of other improvements, we'll set up a new post as well, so stay tuned!

You can also stay in the loop by [url=https://discord.gg/aXbpUsKVt5]joining us on Discord[/url].

Until then, have a nice week!
